text: What review frequency does DORA require for a bank's ICT risk management framework, and which events should trigger an ad hoc review outside the regular review cycle?
How often do we have to review how our bank handles IT risks under DORA, and what kinds of events mean we need an extra review in between the regular ones?

Estoy preparando el calendario de revisiones del marco de riesgo TIC del banco: ¿cada cuánto pide DORA que se revise y qué tiene que pasar para que toque hacer una revisión extra fuera de ese calendario?

We operate a small payment business under our Member State's exemption for small payment institutions rather than holding full authorisation as a payment institution, and I have assumed that the exemption also places us outside the scope of DORA. Does DORA apply to our business at all?

I run a small payments company that works under my country's exemption for small payment firms instead of having a full licence. I assumed being exempt also means DORA doesn't apply to us. Is my business covered by DORA at all?

Tengo una empresa de pagos pequeña que funciona acogida a la exención para pequeñas entidades de pago de nuestro país, sin licencia completa. Yo daba por hecho que al estar exentos DORA no va con nosotros, ¿es así o nos aplica igualmente?

How frequently is a crypto-asset service provider that holds clients' crypto-assets in custody required to provide each client with a statement of the crypto-assets it holds for that client, and are clients entitled to request such a statement between the periodic ones?

We run a crypto exchange that keeps our customers' tokens for them. How often do we have to send each customer a statement of the crypto we're holding for them, and can customers also ask us for one in between?

Trabajo en un exchange de criptomonedas que custodia los tokens de sus clientes. ¿Cada cuánto tenemos que enviar a cada cliente un extracto de los criptoactivos que le guardamos, y puede el cliente pedirnos uno entre medias?

Can a Singapore-based crypto exchange with no MiCA authorisation continue serving clients in Germany who were onboarded on a reverse solicitation basis, without having to obtain an EU authorisation, and may it email those clients about the new tokens and services it is about to launch?

Our crypto exchange is based in Singapore and has no EU license. Some people in Germany found us by themselves and signed up. Can we keep serving them without getting licensed in the EU, and can we email them about the new tokens and services we're about to launch?

Nuestro exchange de cripto está en Singapur y no tiene licencia MiCA, pero se nos han registrado clientes en Alemania que nos encontraron por su cuenta. ¿Podemos seguir dándoles servicio sin tener que pedir licencia en la UE? ¿Y podemos mandarles correos anunciando los tokens y servicios nuevos que vamos a lanzar?

As a crypto-asset service provider authorised under MiCA, what information on the originator and on the beneficiary must accompany each transfer of crypto-assets we send to another crypto-asset service provider?
Our crypto exchange is licensed under MiCA. When we send crypto to another exchange, what details about the sender and the receiver have to go along with every transfer?
Somos un exchange con licencia MiCA: ¿qué datos de quien envía y de quien recibe tenemos que mandar con cada transferencia de cripto que hacemos a otro exchange?

Under MiCA, what must the business continuity policy of a mid-sized crypto-asset service provider operating an exchange contain, both as regards the objectives it must achieve and the ICT business continuity and recovery plans it must include?

We run a medium-sized crypto exchange licensed under the EU crypto rules and we're writing our plan for keeping the business going if something breaks. What does that plan have to include, both what it's supposed to achieve and which plans it needs for keeping our IT systems running and getting them back up after an outage?

Tenemos un exchange cripto mediano con licencia MiCA y estamos redactando la política de continuidad de negocio: ¿qué tiene que incluir según la normativa cripto, tanto en cuanto a los objetivos que debe cumplir como a los planes de continuidad y recuperación TIC que hay que tener?
Within what timeframe must a payment service provider respond to a consumer complaint about a duplicate card transaction, and in which circumstances may that timeframe be extended?
My card was charged twice for the same purchase and I complained to my bank. How long do they have to answer me, and when are they allowed to take longer?
Me han cobrado dos veces el mismo pago con tarjeta y he puesto una reclamación al banco, ¿cuánto tiempo tienen para contestarme y en qué casos pueden tardar más?

A consumer has only just noticed that her gym collected a direct debit approximately six weeks ago for a substantially higher amount than the usual monthly charge. She signed the direct debit mandate, but it did not state a fixed amount. Is she still entitled to a refund from her payment service provider notwithstanding the signed mandate?

I only just noticed my gym took a lot more than my usual monthly fee by direct debit about six weeks ago. I signed the direct debit form, but it didn't say a fixed amount. Can I still get my money back from my bank even though I signed it?

Me acabo de dar cuenta de que hace unas seis semanas el gimnasio me pasó un recibo domiciliado mucho más alto que la cuota de siempre. Firmé la domiciliación, pero en la hoja no ponía ninguna cantidad fija. ¿Todavía puedo pedirle al banco que me devuelva el dinero aunque firmé la domiciliación?

We are renegotiating the contract with the ICT third-party service provider that operates our core banking platform. In which circumstances must the bank be able to terminate the contractual arrangement?
We're renegotiating our deal with the company that runs our bank's core banking system. In what situations does the bank have to be able to end the contract with them?
En el banco estamos renegociando el contrato con el proveedor que nos lleva el core bancario. ¿En qué casos tenemos que poder rescindirlo?
What is the maximum administrative fine a national competent authority may impose on a mid-sized insurance undertaking for non-compliance with DORA?
What's the biggest fine our national regulator could give our mid-sized insurance company for not following DORA?
Somos una aseguradora mediana: si el supervisor nacional nos multa por no cumplir con DORA, ¿cuál es la multa máxima que nos podría caer?

Under DORA, where a credit institution has detected a significant cyber threat targeting it but no incident has occurred and no systems or services have been affected, is it required to notify its competent authority of the threat, as it is for a major ICT-related incident?

Our bank spotted a serious cyber threat aimed at us, but nothing actually happened and none of our systems or services were affected. Do we have to report it to our regulator under DORA, the same way we would have to with a major incident?

Hemos detectado una ciberamenaza seria contra el banco, pero no ha llegado a producirse ningún incidente y no se ha visto afectado ningún sistema ni servicio. ¿DORA nos obliga a comunicárselo al supervisor igual que cuando hay un incidente grave?

Our bank has been required by its competent authority to conduct threat-led penetration testing under DORA. Instead of engaging an external testing provider, are we permitted to use our in-house red team as the testers?

Our regulator told our bank it has to run those simulated cyberattack tests under DORA. Can we just have our own security people play the hackers and do the tests, instead of paying an outside company?
Somos un banco y el supervisor nos ha exigido hacer un TLPT por DORA. ¿Podemos hacerlo con nuestro propio red team interno en vez de contratar a una empresa externa para las pruebas?

We are a software company providing an ICT service to a large number of financial entities; all of our clients operate exclusively in the Member State where we are established, and we do not provide the service in any other Member State. Our management assumes that, given the number of financial entities relying on us, we could be designated under DORA as a critical ICT third-party service provider subject to EU-level oversight. Can we be designated as critical?

My company sells an IT service that a lot of financial companies use, but every one of them only does business in our home EU country, and we only offer the service there. Because so many financial companies depend on us, our managers think we could be labeled a critical IT provider under DORA and end up supervised at EU level. Can we really be labeled critical?

Somos una empresa de software y muchísimas entidades financieras usan nuestro servicio informático, aunque todas operan solo en nuestro país y nosotros tampoco lo ofrecemos fuera de aquí. En la dirección dan por hecho que, al tener tantos clientes del sector financiero, con DORA nos pueden declarar proveedor crítico y pasaríamos a estar supervisados a nivel europeo. ¿Es posible que de verdad nos designen como críticos?

Under what conditions does DORA permit a bank to share cyber threat information, such as indicators of compromise and threat actor tactics, with other financial entities in a threat intelligence sharing group it intends to join?

My bank wants to join a group of other financial companies that swap info about cyber attacks, like signs a system has been hacked and the tricks attackers use. What conditions does DORA put on us sharing that kind of info with the others in the group?

Queremos que el banco entre en un grupo con otras entidades financieras para intercambiar información sobre ciberamenazas, tipo IOCs o tácticas de los atacantes. ¿Qué condiciones nos pone DORA para poder compartir esa información con el resto de miembros del grupo?
As a cloud service provider recently designated as a critical ICT third-party service provider under DORA, what amount of oversight fees will we be required to pay annually?
Our cloud company just got named a critical IT provider for the EU financial sector under DORA. How much are we going to have to pay each year in supervision fees?
Somos un proveedor cloud y nos acaban de designar como proveedor TIC crítico con DORA, ¿cuánto nos va a tocar pagar cada año en tasas de supervisión?

Our start-up intends to make an offer to the public in the EU of a new crypto-asset that is neither a stablecoin nor a financial instrument. We have assumed that the national competent authority must approve the crypto-asset white paper before the offer is launched. Is such prior approval of the white paper actually required before the offer can proceed?

We're a start-up planning to sell a brand-new crypto token to the public in the EU. It isn't a stablecoin, and it isn't a share, bond or similar investment. We assumed our country's financial regulator has to approve our white paper before we can launch the sale. Do we actually need their approval before we go ahead?

Estamos montando una startup y queremos sacar un token nuevo y venderlo al público en la UE. No es una stablecoin ni un instrumento financiero. Dábamos por hecho que el regulador de nuestro país tiene que aprobarnos el white paper antes de lanzar la venta. ¿Es así? ¿Necesitamos su aprobación antes de poder arrancar con la oferta?
Is a retail holder of a stablecoin referencing a basket of several fiat currencies and gold entitled to require the issuer to redeem her tokens for payment at any time of her choosing?

I'm a small private investor holding some stablecoin tokens whose value is tied to a mix of several currencies plus gold. Can I make the company that issued them take the tokens back and pay me out whenever I want?
Soy pequeña inversora y tengo tokens de una stablecoin cuyo valor está ligado a una cesta de varias divisas y oro. ¿Puedo exigir al emisor que me los recompre y me pague en el momento que yo quiera?

Is a technology start-up that holds no financial licence or authorisation of any kind permitted, in its current status, to issue its own stablecoin pegged one-to-one to the euro and offer it to the public in the EU?

We're a tech start-up with no financial licence at all. Are we allowed to launch our own stablecoin that's always worth exactly one euro and sell it to the general public in the EU, as things stand right now?

Somos una startup tecnológica y no tenemos ninguna licencia financiera. Queremos sacar nuestra propia stablecoin, 1 a 1 con el euro, y ofrecerla al público en la UE. ¿Podemos emitirla tal y como estamos ahora?

An employee of a crypto-asset service provider operating a trading platform learned through her work, before any public announcement, that her employer would shortly list a crypto-asset already traded on other crypto-asset trading platforms; given that listings on that platform typically cause a sharp rise in the price, did her purchase of that crypto-asset for her personal account on another platform before the announcement breach the EU market abuse rules applicable to crypto-assets?

I work at a crypto exchange and found out at work, before it was announced publicly, that we were about to list a token that was already traded on other exchanges. Tokens usually jump in price when we list them. Before the announcement, I bought some of that token for myself on a different exchange. Did that break the EU rules against market abuse in crypto?

Una empleada de nuestro exchange de criptomonedas se enteró por su trabajo, antes de que se anunciara públicamente, de que íbamos a listar pronto un token que ya se negocia en otras plataformas cripto. Cuando listamos un token el precio suele dispararse, y antes del anuncio ella compró algunos a título personal en otra plataforma. ¿Ha incumplido con esa compra la normativa europea contra el abuso de mercado en cripto?

As a consumer association, we are concerned about a meme coin (a crypto-asset that is not a stablecoin) being aggressively marketed and sold to retail investors across the EU. Does ESMA have the power to impose a temporary EU-wide prohibition on its marketing and sale?

Our consumer group is worried about a meme coin that's being pushed hard on ordinary people all over the EU. It's a crypto token, not a stablecoin. Can ESMA, the EU's markets watchdog, temporarily ban it from being advertised and sold across the whole EU?

Somos una asociación de consumidores y nos preocupa una memecoin que se está anunciando y vendiendo de forma muy agresiva a pequeños inversores en toda la UE. No es una stablecoin, es un token cripto. ¿Puede la ESMA prohibir temporalmente su publicidad y su venta en toda la Unión Europea?

Our investment fund intends to acquire 25% of the shares of a crypto-asset exchange authorised under MiCA. Is the fund required to notify the exchange's competent authority before completing the acquisition?
Our fund is planning to buy 25% of the shares in a crypto exchange that's licensed under MiCA. Do we have to tell the exchange's regulator before the purchase goes through?

Estoy revisando una operación en la que nuestro fondo va a comprar el 25% de las acciones de un exchange de criptomonedas con licencia MiCA. ¿Tenemos que notificarlo al supervisor del exchange antes de cerrar la compra?

We have operated a crypto-asset exchange under our Member State's national crypto-asset regime since before MiCA became applicable, and our application for MiCA authorisation is still pending. Until when may we continue to provide crypto-asset services without that authorisation?

Our crypto exchange has been running under our country's own crypto rules since before the new EU crypto law kicked in, and we've applied for the EU licence but haven't heard back yet. How long can we keep serving customers without it?

Tenemos un exchange de cripto que lleva funcionando con la normativa de nuestro país desde antes de que MiCA empezara a aplicarse. Hemos pedido la licencia MiCA y seguimos esperando respuesta: ¿hasta cuándo podemos seguir dando servicio a nuestros clientes sin tenerla?

What minimum initial capital must a newly established firm hold to obtain authorisation as a payment institution if it will provide only money remittance services, without opening payment accounts for its customers?

My co-founder and I are starting a business that only sends money abroad for customers, without opening accounts for them. We're applying for a payment institution licence, so what's the minimum amount of money we need to have in the company to get it?

Mi socio y yo queremos montar una empresa solo de envíos de dinero al extranjero, sin abrir cuentas a los clientes, y vamos a pedir la licencia de entidad de pago. ¿Cuánto capital mínimo necesitamos tener para que nos la concedan?

What minimum advance notice must a bank give consumer customers before an increase in the monthly fee on their existing current accounts, applied under the framework contracts already in force, takes effect?
How much notice does a bank have to give its customers before raising the monthly fee on the personal current accounts they already have open with it?
¿Con cuánta antelación tiene que avisar el banco a sus clientes particulares antes de subirles la comisión mensual de mantenimiento de las cuentas corrientes que ya tienen abiertas?

Is the payer's payment service provider liable for recovering or refunding the funds when a consumer supplies a payee IBAN containing a single-digit error, the PSP executes the credit transfer, and the amount is credited to an account held by an unrelated third party?
I sent a bank transfer and typed one digit of the IBAN wrong myself. My bank processed it and the money went to a stranger's account. Is my bank responsible for getting my money back?
Me equivoqué en un número del IBAN al hacer una transferencia, el banco la tramitó y el dinero ha ido a parar a la cuenta de un desconocido. ¿Le toca a mi banco recuperarme el dinero?

A consumer's payment card was stolen and the thief used it for online purchases; the issuing bank did not require strong customer authentication for those transactions, and there is no fraud on the consumer's part. The consumer believes a payer always bears the first EUR 50 of losses from a stolen card. Is she required to bear any part of the loss from these unauthorised transactions herself?

My bank card was stolen and the thief used it to buy things online. The bank never asked for any extra check on those purchases, like a code sent to my phone, and I didn't do anything dishonest. I thought customers always have to cover the first 50 euros when a card is stolen. Do I have to pay any part of the loss myself?

Me han robado la tarjeta y el ladrón la ha usado para comprar por internet. En esas compras el banco no pidió ninguna verificación adicional, como un código por SMS al móvil, y yo no he hecho nada deshonesto. Siempre había oído que los primeros 50 euros de una tarjeta robada los paga el cliente, ¿me toca pagar a mí alguna parte de lo que ha gastado el ladrón?
For an e-commerce merchant reviewing its card acceptance costs, what is the maximum interchange fee that may be applied to consumer debit card transactions in the EU?
I run a small online shop and pay fees on every card payment. What's the maximum fee the customer's bank is allowed to take in the EU when someone pays with an ordinary personal debit card?

Tengo una tienda online pequeña y estoy revisando lo que me cuesta cada cobro con tarjeta: ¿hasta cuánto puede llegar la tasa de intercambio en la UE cuando un cliente particular paga con tarjeta de débito?

Where a consumer has recently relocated to another Member State and two credit institutions there have refused her application for a payment account with basic features, is a credit institution in that Member State obliged under EU law to open such an account for her?
I've just moved to another EU country and two banks here have refused to give me a basic bank account. Under EU rules, does a bank here have to open one for me?
Me acabo de mudar a otro país de la UE y dos bancos de aquí me han denegado la cuenta básica. ¿Hay alguna norma europea que obligue a algún banco de aquí a abrírmela?

We are an authorised payment institution and have suffered a major ICT-related incident. Under DORA, must we submit our report on this incident to the same competent authority that granted our payment institution authorisation, or to a different authority?

I'm in charge of IT at a licensed payment company and we've had a serious IT incident. Under DORA, who do we have to send our report on it to: the same regulator that gave us our payment licence, or a different one?

Soy el responsable de IT de una entidad de pago y hemos tenido un incidente TIC grave. Con DORA, ¿el informe del incidente se lo tenemos que mandar al mismo supervisor que nos dio la licencia de entidad de pago o a otra autoridad distinta?

We are a fintech registered with our national competent authority. With each user's consent, our app collects the balances and transactions of the user's accounts held at several banks and displays them in one place; we never hold or transfer user funds. Our founders assume that DORA applies only to credit institutions and authorised payment institutions. Is that assumption correct, or does DORA apply to our firm?

Our fintech has an app that, if people give us permission, pulls the balances and transactions from their accounts at different banks and shows them all in one place. We never hold or move anyone's money, and we're registered with our country's financial regulator. Our founders think DORA is only for banks and licensed payment companies. Are they right, or does DORA apply to us too?

Tenemos una fintech con una app que, si el usuario nos da permiso, se conecta a sus cuentas de distintos bancos y le enseña en un solo sitio los saldos y los movimientos. Nunca guardamos ni movemos el dinero de nadie y estamos registrados ante el supervisor de nuestro país. Los fundadores están convencidos de que DORA es solo cosa de bancos y de entidades de pago con licencia. ¿Es así, o a nosotros también nos toca cumplir DORA?
